title: Louis Armstrong meets McPartland's Scottish mother
summary: His mother, who offers tea to every visitor, asks Louis if he'll have tea, causing alarm; she then invites him to dinner between shows.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong
